schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all non-major devDependencies into one PR — low risk, high volume.
Group type definitions; they move constantly and rarely break anything alone.
Vue ecosystem moves in lockstep — upgrading one without the others breaks builds.
PrimeVue and its theming are tightly coupled.
Fastify core and its plugins must move together.
Mongoose majors change query and index semantics — never batch these.
Majors always land alone and are never auto-merged.
Pin the Node major to what the Dockerfile actually runs.

_comment_automerge: Automerge is deliberately OFF everywhere. Renovate merging green PRs is only safe when CI actually runs the suite on each PR; there is no CI pipeline in this repo yet. Once a workflow runs `npm test` and `vue-tsc --noEmit` on pull requests, enable automerge for the devDependencies and type-definition groups first.
